context: Bee swarm plot showing income distribution of 400 synthetic people colored by education level, with percentile markers and a marginal box plot — a data visualization
first_impression: Annotated and data-rich but the swarm occupies only the upper third of the canvas, leaving a large dead zone between it and the box plot that makes the layout feel unbalanced and incomplete.
what_works: Deliberate use of a colorblind-safe Tol palette (#4477AA, #228833, #CCBB44, #EE6677) rather than schemeCategory10 shows real color intent; S-curve leader-line callouts for the top 5 earners are an ambitious annotation layer that adds editorial value.
what_doesnt: The vertical gap between the swarm (~upper 35% of inner height) and the marginal box plot (~bottom 5%) wastes roughly 60% of the canvas — this is a proportioning failure, not intentional whitespace. The five callout labels crowd into a narrow band in the upper-right, overlapping each other and becoming hard to parse individually.
